name: 80s AI Trend: Your 1985 Photo and Home Video
blurb: The 80s AI trend (also called "Back in '85") restyles your selfie as a real-looking 1985 photo: big mid-80s hair, a bright jacket, film grain, direct flash and a red-orange date stamp.

prompts.label: 1. Open [AI Photo with this template](https://www.makeviral.ai/photo?template=80s-ai-trend) and add your photo (your selfie). The photo prompt is filled in
prompts.text: Use the uploaded image as the base. Keep the subject's face, facial features, skin tone, and expression exactly the same. Transform the photo into a real 1985 snapshot: bold mid-1980s hair, a bright windbreaker or denim jacket, statement accessories, in a wood-panelled suburban living room with a boxy TV and a cassette player. Analog film grain, faded warm colors, direct flash, soft focus. A small red-orange date stamp in the lower right corner. Vertical 9:16. No modern objects, no phones, no logos.

prompts.label: 3. Press the film button on the still to open AI Video with the still as the first frame. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 10 s, 720p, 9:16, sound on. The video prompt
prompts.text: A 1985 home video filmed on a consumer camcorder by a parent. Keep the person's face, hair and outfit exactly as in the image. The person notices the camera, laughs, fixes their hair, then walks outside past a station wagon and waves while riding a bike slowly down a sunny suburban street. Soft low-resolution analog video, color bleed, faint tracking lines at the bottom edge, handheld shake, autofocus hunting, a blinking date stamp in the lower right corner. Audio: camcorder mic ambience only, tape hiss, birds, a bike chain, a parent laughing off camera. No music, no modern objects, no logos.
